rows.text: The party page reports that 'Eleven sets of nomination papers, all proposing the name of Shri Bangaru Laxman, for the post of the President of the Bharatiya Janata Party were filed with Shri Om Prakash Kohli, Returning Officer' at the Central Office that morning; the table lists the 'Nomination papers for the post of National President received today i.e. 2nd August, 2000'.
